text:
7 hours ago Manufacturing in Westlake, OH is busy right now, with solid openings for hands-on pros who like making real products and working with advanced equipment.
Here are several strong roles worth a look:
Computer Numerical Control Programmer Employer: Teksky LLC Location: Westlake, OH (relocation help offered) Salary: $50,000–$80,000/year Type: Full-time, On-site Work as a CNC Programmer & Operator in a stone fabrication shop, using your CAD/CAM and CNC skills on stone, granite, quartz, and countertop projects. Comes with health, dental, vision, 401(k) with match , paid time off, disability, life insurance, uniforms, and room to grow. Surface Grinder - Tool Room Operator Employer: The L.S. Starrett Company Location: Westlake, OH Salary: Not listed Type: Full-time Run multiple surface grinders, prep stock, and inspect precision parts using micrometers and calipers in a tool room setting. Good fit if you have strong mechanical aptitude, like detailed work, and are comfortable on your feet and lifting up to 50 lbs.
